checked_scope: Finite-type existence proof's boundary and supply-pruning steps; two counterexamples
checks: The exhausted-budget utility condition makes the continuous extension exclude all infeasible/exhausted choices, giving closed optimal-distribution correspondences and the finite Kakutani hypotheses.

At a fixed point positive excess forces price P>all endowments, contradicting positive demand. Oversupply forces price zero and zero-cost supplying producers; scaling each quality by D/S and moving mass outside preserves optimality and clears exactly, including D=0.

Payment cancellation proves aggregate numeraire identity. The first one-quality example has no clearing price even with mixing; the second clears only by consumer mixing at price1/2, distinguishing type kernels from atomless selection.
